sn22.136:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Tatra-voca || || Rūpam bhikkhave kukkuḷam || vedanā kukkuḷā || saññā kukkuḷā || saṅkhārā kukkuḷā || viññāṇaṃ kukkuḷām || || Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmim pi nibbindati || vedanāya pi || saññāya pi || saṅkhāresu pi || viññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || || Nibbindaṃ virajjati || || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
